subject: Request: priority sprint slot for CrimsonBank pilot - tenant routing & audit export
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: priority sprint slot for CrimsonBank pilot - tenant routing & audit export

Marissa / Ben / Karthik,

Quick ask — CrimsonBank (contact: David Lee) is running a pilot with us that will convert to a paid, reserved-capacity contract if we can deliver two items before their production pilot start (target: 2026-10-01):

1) Tenant-level routing policy: ability to pin requests from CrimsonBank to a dedicated routing lane (logical routing + config UI flags) so their internal compliance team can guarantee isolation for pilot traffic.
2) Audit export: per-tenant export of request/response traces and token-level metadata for 90-day retention into a S3 endpoint they control (SOC audit requirement).

Commercial context: the deal is a 12‑month reserved capacity commitment with expected ARR ~USD 620k. Legal is willing to sign an MSA with a pilot carve-out, but CrimsonBank needs both capabilities enforced before pilot. They asked us to confirm feasibility and a target delivery window by EOD Thu (8/27) to keep the internal sponsor aligned.

Ask: can product/eng prioritize a focused sprint slot (one cross-functional sprint, approx 2 weeks of concentrated effort) to deliver a minimum viable version of routing + audit export? I know this is off-roadmap; happy to trade scope (e.g., limit export fields, manual config steps) and coordinate with SE/CS for implementation work.

I've attached the mutual action plan and the SOW draft that outline timelines/commitments. If we can surface an estimate and proposed scope today, I will escalate from CrimsonBank to lock in the pilot.

Files attached: CrimsonBank_MutualActionPlan_v3.pdf; CrimsonBank_SOW_draft.docx

Thanks — short sync ok anytime today.

Alex
Alex Martinez | Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: priority sprint slot for CrimsonBank pilot - tenant routing & audit export

Alex — thanks for the context and the attachments. A few quick clarifying questions before I take this to product steering: 

- Scope for "tenant-level routing": do you mean a simple tenant-to-route mapping (config + toggle) at the edge that routes to an existing dedicated lane, or do we need affinity/placement changes at the scheduler level? The former is much faster.
- Audit export: which exact fields do they require? Do they need full token text, or will metadata + hashes suffice? Full token text + long retention is heavier and has compliance implications.
- SLA expectations during pilot: are they insisting on a latency SLA or just data isolation and export?

If this can be narrowed to: config toggle for tenant->route + export of metadata (timestamps, trace ids, token counts, anonymized text hashes) to their S3, I can likely push for a prioritized sprint slot and ask Eng for an initial LOE (T+2 days). If they require per-token plaintext export or scheduler-level residency guarantees, that's a larger lift.

Please reply with answers inline. Also paste any Exec-level commitment (email or internal confirmation) that we can show our steering committee.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole | Product Manager, Deployments | Redwood Inference

Marissa — answers inline: 

- Routing: they only need a logical tenant->route mapping for the pilot. They do not require scheduler-level residency for the pilot (that's a potential follow-on ask). So config toggle + route mapping is acceptable.
- Audit export: CrimsonBank's security lead said they can accept anonymized token text (hashed) + full metadata (trace id, timestamps, model id, token counts). They explicitly do NOT require raw token export for pilot.
- SLA: pilot wants isolation and traceability, not a strict latency SLA.

Attached the MAP and SOW draft (same files). Exec sponsor (Priya Anand, AVP Security) confirmed via email that pilot will go ahead if both capabilities are demonstrable in the pilot environment. She is willing to sign the SOW contingent on delivery.

Can we do a short triage sync at 3:00 PM PT today to scope the MVP and capture LOE? If we can commit to a 2-week focused slot (with product/eng time), CrimsonBank has indicated they'll sign the pilot SOW and move to a reserved capacity PO immediately after pilot success.

Thanks — I appreciate the quick turnaround.

Alex

Attachments: CrimsonBank_MutualActionPlan_v3.pdf; CrimsonBank_SOW_draft.docx

Thanks for the context — initial engineering read:

- Tenant->route config toggle (edge mapping only): low-medium effort. We can implement a config-driven mapping in the routing layer that tags incoming requests and routes them to an existing dedicated lane. Estimated effort: 4 engineers * 3 working days (including QA + small console change) = ~12 engineer-days.
- Audit export (metadata + hashed token text to S3): medium effort. We need a durable export pipeline, S3 presigned delivery, and retention control. Estimated effort: 3 engineers * 6 working days = ~18 engineer-days. We also need to confirm compliance expectations (encryption, customer-managed KMS).

Combined LOE is roughly 30 engineer-days. If we carve this into a focused sprint slot, realistically we will need 2 weeks of concentrated sprinting with a small follow-up patch week for fixes. To make this feasible without derailing other roadmap items, proposal:

Option A (fast): MVP scope — edge-only routing config + limited export (metadata + hashed token text, 90-day retention, Redwood-managed KMS). Delivery target: 2-week focused sprint. Trade-off: no customer-managed KMS for pilot; scheduler residency not included.

Option B (gold): routing + export + CMK + scheduler affinity work — Delivery target: 6–8 weeks.

If Sales can confirm that CrimsonBank will accept Option A for the pilot and commit to sign and pay for the reserved capacity after pilot success, we can schedule a prioritized sprint slot (we'll need Product to allocate PM and Eng capacity and Growth/Support to own rollout).

I can join the 3:00 PM PT sync to walk through technical risks.

—Ben
Ben Carter | Engineering Manager, Serving Runtime | Redwood Inference
